_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "migration_log" ("version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "applied_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("version"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "business_profiles" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "address" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "phone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "gstin" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "fssai" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "upi_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "bill_footer" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INR', "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "printer_profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "connection_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "paper_width" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "mac_address" TEXT NULL, "vendor_id" INTEGER NULL, "product_id" INTEGER NULL, "device_name" TEXT NULL, "ip_address" TEXT NULL, "port" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 9100, "last_connected_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "print_jobs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "print_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_role" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_printer_id" TEXT NULL, "source_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "retry_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "error_message" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "processed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "print_history" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "job_id" TEXT NULL, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "printer_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "connection_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "print_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_success" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_success" IN (0, 1)), "error_message" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audit_log" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "staff_id" TEXT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NULL, "details_json" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tax_profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate_bp" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_inclusive" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_inclusive" IN (0, 1)), "split_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "kitchen_stations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "menu_categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES menu_categories (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "menu_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES menu_categories (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "sku" TEXT NULL, "base_price_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tax_profile_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES tax_profiles (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "food_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'veg', "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "available_dine_in" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("available_dine_in" IN (0, 1)), "available_takeaway" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("available_takeaway" IN (0, 1)), "station_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES kitchen_stations (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "is_favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_favorite" IN (0, 1)), "prep_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "image_path" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "option_groups" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "min_select" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "max_select" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "option_choices" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES option_groups (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "price_delta_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "item_option_groups" ("item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES menu_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES option_groups (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("item_id", "group_id"));
CREATE INDEX idx_print_jobs_status ON print_jobs (status)
CREATE INDEX idx_print_jobs_source_key ON print_jobs (source_key)
CREATE INDEX idx_print_history_at ON print_history (at)
CREATE INDEX idx_audit_log_at ON audit_log (at)
CREATE INDEX idx_menu_categories_parent ON menu_categories (parent_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_menu_items_category ON menu_items (category_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_menu_items_sku ON menu_items (sku)
CREATE INDEX idx_option_choices_group ON option_choices (group_id)
